events.name: Handmade for the Holidays at Gore Place
events.note: Rain or shine. No dogs except service animals.
events.why: A holiday market with 60 artisan vendors on the grounds of a 19th-century estate, where you can also see heritage-breed sheep.

events.name: Newbery Street Coffee pop-up at merai.bar
events.why: A weekend pop-up café serving N-Pan salt bread, Thai-style rice porridge, pour-over coffee, matcha and Thai tea.

events.name: Harboring Creativity: East Boston Artists Group show & sale
events.why: Annual show and sale with 20+ local artists at the Watershed; listed free by the Globe.

events.name: The Brighton Bazaar: Fall Season Finale

events.name: Silents, Please! Grass (live score)
